# KaTeX

Client-side LaTeX math renderer. It is the **only** third-party dependency anywhere in
[[physics-exam-prep]], and the reason that repo contains 20 `.woff2` font files — a fact that looks
like build residue until you know what it is.

## How it is included

Three files under `exam_prep/vendor/katex/`, committed into the repository:

| File | Size | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `katex.min.js` | 277 KB | the renderer |
| `katex.min.css` | 23 KB | the stylesheet — this is what references the fonts |
| `auto-render.min.js` | 3.5 KB | scans the DOM and renders delimited math in place |
| `fonts/KaTeX_*.woff2` | ×20 | AMS, Main, Math, SansSerif, Script, Size1–4, Caligraphic, Fraktur, Typewriter |

Loaded by two plain `<script src="vendor/…">` tags and one `<link rel="stylesheet">` in a
hand-authored `index.html`. No bundler, no package manager, no import map — see
[[zero-dependency-no-build-step]].

The `auto-render` plugin is why the knowledge base can store math as ordinary strings: `js/data.js`
writes `\(…\)` delimiters inline and the renderer finds them after the page is built, so nothing in
the app has to know KaTeX exists.

## Why it is vendored rather than fetched

Recorded as [[vendor-katex-instead-of-cdn]]. The one-line justification is written into the app's
own structural map:

> "        └── katex/                  # bundled KaTeX (offline math) — no CDN needed"
> — Physics/exam_prep/snapshot.md, 2026-06-30

A study tool whose formulas silently fail to render when the Wi-Fi is off is not a study tool. All
23 KaTeX assets are listed in the service worker's `CORE` precache array, and `tools/qa.mjs`
statically checks that every formula in the knowledge base actually parses — so a malformed LaTeX
string fails the harness rather than the exam-eve revision session.

## Why KaTeX rather than MathJax

The functional argument is that KaTeX renders synchronously and self-contained, with no font
fetching at runtime beyond the files already on disk, which is precisely what a `file://`
deliverable needs — [[offline-first-static-deliverable]]. MathJax's fuller LaTeX coverage buys
nothing for a syllabus of physics formulas.

## Cost of the choice

~304 KB of JS/CSS plus the font files, committed permanently and updated by hand or not at all.
There is no version pin and no update path recorded anywhere — the vendored copy is frozen at
whatever was current on 2026-06-27, the earliest mtime in the repo.
